ownership: Existing P2, P3, P4 and other report owners retain their frozen work; this record does not reset budgets or adopt their results.

value_P3.acceptance_question: Does an as-disclosed annual ordinary-share book-equity/actual fiscal-year-end ordinary-share market-value measure improve monthly selection beyond the same eligible stocks' momentum and gross-profit information, while recording missed gains, downside and operating cost?
value_P3.existing_result_and_scope: One annual book-to-price definition was conditionally chosen, without an effect run. Six local price/book checks at three companies' disclosed anchors matched the published ratios, not a full historical version guarantee. Eight selected annual filing cases were inspected; five original PDFs yielded partial fields and three lacked a qualified consolidated balance sheet. The P2 source effort completed annual and correction catalogues for all 600 fixed historical stocks, recorded 13,778 PDF source operations, and qualified 584/600 source codes for its separate profitability use; that does not qualify value/share/price fields or mean 13,778 unique PDFs were saved. The other owner's 2026-10-20 value-momentum report reproduces public US portfolio statistics and a Chinese public value series, but does not reconstruct this cohort's stock-level value inputs or compare them with local momentum.
real_blockers: Across the 600-stock cohort, no verified history of fiscal-year-end ordinary-share count, other-equity instruments, treasury shares and multi-class share market values is bound to each original filing version.

The saved 600-stock daily cache requested adjustflag=2 and omits unadjusted year-end prices, total shares and vendor valuation fields. A/B/H classes require additional same-date quotes; adjusted prices cannot be used as raw market value.

Original publication/correction dates exist in the source catalog, but the source panel was qualified for profitability fields, not for each year's ordinary equity and correction chain. No value effect can be claimed from eight cases or from the published portfolio series.
value_P3.locally_executable_minimum_next: Without a new request or effect computation, join the already saved 600-stock annual/correction manifest to a fixed small set of fiscal years spanning early, middle and late cohort history; audit the original PDF pages for consolidated parent equity, other equity, fiscal-year-end ordinary shares, share class and any correction date, recording pass/missing/ambiguous with original path and hash. Use the existing source panel's dates and code list, and do not scan or redownload the full PDF collection. This will distinguish a locally repairable parser gap from absent source fields. Then a separately frozen raw-price/share-class acquisition is still required before an annual book-to-price effect run.
value_P3.why_not_duplicate: The eight-case check only tested selected annual anchors and partial extraction; this asks whether the much larger already saved filing collection contains the missing value numerator/share evidence across time. The public portfolio replication is a method reference, not a repeat of this source audit.
value_P3.budget_readback: P3: source qualification requests 5/6, valuation source operations 4/4, core effects 0/1, purposeful followups 0/3. A reserved effect slot is not qualified input or permission to replace missing data. P2's completed core and 2/3 followups remain separate.

defensive_P4.acceptance_question: For the same low-frequency eligible opportunities and one fixed capital base, can a defensive choice reduce real downside or recovery time enough to justify foregone upside, turnover, concentration and maintenance versus simple equal exposure or lower capital exposure?
defensive_P4.existing_result_and_scope: The first-cycle four-ETF saved-prediction diagnostic covered 317 common dates in 2025 and 2026 H1. The model including recent 20-day volatility changed the two selected ETFs on only 11 dates and selected future volatility 0.00324 percentage points higher than the strong product-specific historical-average comparator; these are averages of two individual volatilities, not account drawdown. The classic risk study also found this model's forecast error worse than that comparator. A separate 14-ETF 2020-2026 account study already compared monthly exit/rapid re-entry with 75% capital exposure and costs; its rapid re-entry result had only a 0.57-point maximum-drawdown advantage over 75% exposure at double fees, so this path must be reused rather than rerun. The newer 300-stock high52 replication found no robust added return and missed more large upside opportunities; it is price-selection evidence, not a defensive portfolio test.
real_blockers: The fixed four-ETF forecast-selection use has reached a negative/weak boundary on already seen dates; new parameters on the same dates would not supply independent evidence.

A distinct 600-stock risk-selection use has not been frozen or tested with matched capital, costs and missing/exit handling. The fixed historical cohort and adjusted daily prices exist; actual delisting proceeds, trade fills and corporate-action-independent price verification remain incomplete, so account-level protection cannot be asserted.
The 14-ETF exit studies and four-ETF forecast choice have different pools, periods and actions and cannot be summed into one result.
defensive_P4.locally_executable_minimum_next: First use the saved 600-stock monthly eligibility and price panel to freeze one clearly different question: within the exact same monthly eligible momentum pool, select the same number of lower-volatility stocks versus momentum-only, while also comparing a fixed lower-capital momentum allocation. Evaluate next-month price downside, large-gain opportunities missed, target replacement and unknown/exit weights on the same dates; keep account drawdown and cost-adjusted claims out until fills and proceeds are qualified. Do one preregistered offline diagnostic only if the saved records contain the required per-stock past volatility, future endpoint and selection weights; otherwise record the precise missing columns. This is exploratory on already viewed years, not fresh validation.
defensive_P4.why_not_duplicate: This tests whether lower-risk stock selection changes the already fixed 600-stock monthly opportunity set after price momentum. The existing four-ETF work tested forecast ranking and individual future volatility; the 14-ETF work tested exit/re-entry and cash exposure. None answers this same-pool stock downside/upside tradeoff. Do not repeat either older run.
defensive_P4.budget_readback: First-cycle shared budget: one new core batch and two purposeful followup batches already used; source requests 5/6. The fixed four-ETF use is closed to parameter searching. A separate P4 stock diagnostic needs a new exact contract and cumulative-attempt accounting, not a reset or an implied free extra batch.

verification.source_fingerprint_scope: Previously recorded hashes and current existence of two relevant manifests were read; no blanket rehash of archived PDFs or transfer to a new owner.
